messages.content: For care whose executing provider's activity is recorded as dental surgery, what was the amount charged, before any reimbursement, in each region where the executing professional practises, the unknown region included, in claims processed in January 2025? input.final_sql:
select r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB, sum(f.PRS_PAI_MNT) as amount
from ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS f
left join ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION r on r.BEN_RES_REG = f.EXE_INS_REG
where f.PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19 and f.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
group by r.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
